About
“A debut that opened doors across three cities.”

Wal grew up in Kenya before starting his modeling career. He made his major runway debut for Prada in January 2023, and has since walked for Louis Vuitton, Valentino, Saint Laurent, Casablanca, Amiri and Lacoste.

Represented by Viva Model Management in Paris, London and Barcelona, Heroes Model Management in New York, and The Agency in Milan. Available for runway, editorial and campaign bookings.
